observation_boundary: Shared group-event packing applied to firing-density proxy; not a validated HFO/LFP forward model. No causal-family masking or K=2 filtering.
loss: Whole-event Gaussian random-feature kernel mean distance on participation, rank, relative timing and fixed spatial moments. Patient-only fixed maps; no angle target. Ranking removes within-sample diagonal term; acceptance uses original nonnegative distance and matched-N training tolerance.

search.local_anchor_rule: Full eight-network eligible candidates only. Preserve joint, participation, rank and timing extrema; deduplicate identities, fill remaining four slots with diverse joint-score candidates.
search.race_rule: Reserve participation, rank and timing experts, then diverse joint-score nominees from the entire unexpanded pool.

adaptation: Reuse all 347 V3 geometries and exact trajectories/calibration. Correct participation nomination and component-specific local coverage. Fresh geometry master seed; shared training networks and independent confirmation unchanged. Review after four rounds.
claims: One-patient development working point; no uniqueness, anatomical-core localization, clinical seizure or formal equilibrium bifurcation claim. Sequential confirmation attempts are logged and are not a single untouched validation experiment.
downstream: Independent numerical confirmation queues raw propagation review. Fig5 requires raw propagation acceptance; no automatic bypass.
